recommendation: Keep the commit as the FHIR-31951 reconciliation. Future work-group handling of unresolved FHIR-54054 can acknowledge that this commit already corrected the same visible typo, but no separate FHIR-54054 decision should be inferred from this Applied/Published issue run.
issue_request: FHIR-31951 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested changing the _include:iterate example from MedicationRequest:performer to MedicationRequest:requester and changing the explanatory text from prescribing Practitioner resources to prescribers because PractitionerRole should also be possible and no explicit target-type filter is needed.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-31951-tagged source commit was found. The adjacent FHIR-31939/FHIR-31491 search rewrite changed the example from MedicationRequest:performer to MedicationRequest:requester, but it left the Practitioner-only prose and introduced a GET-side Medication:prescription typo while the POST example used MedicationDispense:prescription.
additional_context: source/search.html is the current FHIR search narrative page, and source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and SearchParameter active in the build. MedicationRequest.requester can reference PractitionerRole and other requester types, while the current MedicationDispense prescription search parameter is MedicationDispense:prescription. FHIR-54054 later noticed the Medication:prescription typo, but it is still Triaged and was not decided separately.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html to say the example returns MedicationRequest resources and their prescribers, and to make the GET example match the POST example with _include=MedicationDispense:prescription followed by _include:iterate=MedicationRequest:requester.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the _include:iterate example prose from Practitioner-only resources to prescribers.
source/search.html: changed the GET example from _include=Medication:prescription to _include=MedicationDispense:prescription.
